verdict.rationale: The docs show agents can be created and managed without the dashboard through the API, the Agents CLI, a coding-assistant skill, and the hosted MCP server. Phone connectivity via SIP trunking is documented, but nothing shows a number being attached or a call being placed programmatically, so only the first step of the end-to-end flow is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented API/CLI/MCP number provisioning and assignment, a documented programmatic outbound-call capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full end-to-end run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
